name: Sextans B
tagline: A Local Group irregular on the group's outer rim — one of the most distant dwarf galaxies bound to our neighborhood.
history: Sextans B (DDO 70) is a Local Group irregular close to the group's outer boundary — its membership is a judgment call, since it sits near the edge of what the group's collective gravity can hold. It keeps making stars slowly and carries a low metallicity like the other distant irregulars. Paired on the sky with Sextans A and NGC 3109, it likely belongs to a small sub-association of dwarfs orbiting the Local Group together.
